list.name: device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device FROM usage_event ORDER BY 1

list.name: harness
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT harness FROM usage_event ORDER BY 1

list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') FROM usage_event WHERE device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS "MTD spend" FROM usage_event WHERE ts >= date_trunc('month', now()) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS "spend" FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens), 0) AS "tokens" FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cache_read_tokens)::float / SUM(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens) END AS "cache-read ratio" FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)

panels.title: Minutes since last ship, per device
panels.description: Wall-clock minutes since each device last shipped to Postgres (max(synced_at)). Ignores the time range and $device on purpose so a silent device stays visible. A device with no new usage ships nothing, so this can stand still while the agent is healthy — 'harness-usage doctor' (last sync/last ship) is the authoritative liveness signal; this is the glanceable one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT device, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(synced_at))) / 60 AS "minutes" FROM usage_event GROUP BY device ORDER BY device

SELECT GREATEST(date_trunc(CASE WHEN $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() <= 86400 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, ts, 'Europe/Brussels'), to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())) AS time, COALESCE(model, '(unpriced)') AS metric, SUM(cost_usd) AS value FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT GREATEST(date_trunc(CASE WHEN $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() <= 86400 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, ts, 'Europe/Brussels'), to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())) AS time,
  SUM(input_tokens) AS "input",
  SUM(output_tokens) AS "output",
  SUM(reasoning_tokens) AS "reasoning",
  SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS "cache read",
  SUM(cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) AS "cache write"
FROM usage_event
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT regexp_replace(COALESCE(project, '(unknown)'), '^.*/', '') AS project, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT device, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cost DESC

SELECT billing, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) AS tokens FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tokens DESC

panels.title: Tokens by project
panels.description: All token kinds, stacked by billing. Local model work costs $0, so it is invisible in Cost by project; here it shows as 'local'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT regexp_replace(COALESCE(project, '(unknown)'), '^.*/', '') AS project,
  SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) FILTER (WHERE billing = 'free') AS "subscription",
  SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) FILTER (WHERE billing = 'local') AS "local",
  SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) FILTER (WHERE billing = 'api') AS "api"
FROM usage_event
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Tokens over time by project
panels.description: All token kinds. The 8 largest projects in the range get their own series (by basename, so a repo on two devices is one series); the rest are summed as (other).

targets.rawSql:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT ts, regexp_replace(COALESCE(project, '(unknown)'), '^.*/', '') AS name,
    input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens AS tokens
  FROM usage_event
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)
), top AS (SELECT name FROM e GROUP BY name ORDER BY SUM(tokens) DESC LIMIT 8)
SELECT GREATEST(date_trunc(CASE WHEN $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() <= 86400 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, ts, 'Europe/Brussels'), to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())) AS time,
  CASE WHEN name IN (SELECT name FROM top) THEN name ELSE '(other)' END AS metric,
  SUM(tokens) AS value
FROM e GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  min(ts) AS started_at,
  harness,
  device,
  regexp_replace(COALESCE(max(project), '(unknown)'), '^.*/', '') AS project,
  mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY model) AS model,
  max(ts) - min(ts) AS duration,
  count(*) AS responses,
  sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_5m_tokens + cache_write_1h_tokens) AS total_tokens,
  sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM usage_event
WHERE device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)
GROUP BY harness, device, session_id
HAVING max(ts) >= $__timeFrom() AND min(ts) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Counterfactual cost over time — actual vs alternatives
panels.description: What the same token stream would have cost at other models' rates. Estimates: token counts are not portable across tokenizers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT GREATEST(date_trunc(CASE WHEN $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() <= 86400 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, ts, 'Europe/Brussels'), to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())) AS time, 'actual (as billed/notional)' AS metric, SUM(cost_usd) AS value FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

-- Filters on the event ts, not usage_scenario_daily.day: a midnight day bucket falls outside any sub-day time range.
SELECT GREATEST(date_trunc(CASE WHEN $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() <= 86400 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, e.ts, 'Europe/Brussels'), to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())) AS time, s.scenario || ' [' || s.cache_model || ']' AS metric, SUM(s.cost_usd) AS value
FROM usage_event e
JOIN usage_scenario s ON s.harness = e.harness AND s.session_id = e.session_id AND s.message_id = e.message_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND s.priced_by <> 'none' AND e.device IN ($device) AND e.harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(e.model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: What the local model is saving
panels.description: Ollama-billed tokens repriced onto hosted models. Local inference has no prompt caching, so context is re-sent as fresh input every turn — which is why the input count is large.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.scenario,
  s.cache_model,
  e.device,
  count(*) AS responses,
  sum(e.input_tokens + e.output_tokens + e.reasoning_tokens) AS tokens,
  sum(s.cost_usd) AS would_have_cost_usd
FROM usage_event e
JOIN usage_scenario s ON s.harness = e.harness AND s.session_id = e.session_id AND s.message_id = e.message_id
WHERE e.billing = 'local' AND s.priced_by <> 'none'
  AND e.device IN ($device) AND e.harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(e.model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY would_have_cost_usd ASC

panels.title: Cheapest alternative per project
panels.description: The decision aid. Check cache_model before acting: a target with 'none' has no prompt caching and bills cache reads at full input rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (project)
  regexp_replace(project, '^.*/', '') AS project,
  scenario,
  cache_model,
  actual_cost_usd,
  scenario_cost_usd,
  delta_usd
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(e.project, '(unknown)') AS project,
    s.scenario,
    s.cache_model,
    sum(e.cost_usd) AS actual_cost_usd,
    sum(s.cost_usd) AS scenario_cost_usd,
    sum(s.cost_usd) - sum(e.cost_usd) AS delta_usd
  FROM usage_event e
  JOIN usage_scenario s ON s.harness = e.harness AND s.session_id = e.session_id AND s.message_id = e.message_id
  WHERE s.priced_by <> 'none'
    AND e.device IN ($device) AND e.harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(e.model, '(unknown)') IN ($model)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
) p
ORDER BY project, scenario_cost_usd ASC

panels.title: Effective rates applied, by model
panels.description: The per-million-token rates actually used to compute cost. A step here is a models.json price change, not a change in your behaviour — which is precisely what storing the rates makes visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT GREATEST(date_trunc(CASE WHEN $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() <= 86400 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, ts, 'Europe/Brussels'), to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())) AS time, model || ' · output' AS metric, avg(rate_output) AS value FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND rate_output IS NOT NULL AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT GREATEST(date_trunc(CASE WHEN $__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom() <= 86400 THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END, ts, 'Europe/Brussels'), to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom())) AS time, model || ' · input' AS metric, avg(rate_input) AS value FROM usage_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND rate_input IS NOT NULL AND device IN ($device) AND harness IN ($harness) AND COALESCE(model, '(unknown)') IN ($model) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
